info.title: Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Booking backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events can invite the person the booking is for (OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE); room and equipment availability remains managed by the booking system. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z. Identity includes university_email. Students, Admins and Managers book under the same rules; an Admin or Manager may also book on behalf of someone (student_id is the person the booking is for, created_by who created it), and only a Manager decides urgent requests and reschedules. A student may submit a request only when the induction for the resource, and any prerequisite induction it lists (for example Advanced needs General), is verified and current through the booking end. Every ordinary request starts as PENDING_APPROVAL and holds its slot during a review window (pending_hold_minutes, default 1440 = 24 hours, Manager-configurable per resource, capped at the booking start). An Admin or Manager approves or rejects it within the window; if nobody decides, the system approves it when it still follows the rules (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) and rejects it otherwise (AUTO_REJECTED_*). Requests for time that is already taken or held are WAITLISTED in submission order and, when the time frees up, become PENDING_APPROVAL with a fresh review window. Induction evidence is always reviewed manually. Bookings must start at least 7 and at most 28 days (4 weeks) ahead by default, including each staff weekly-series occurrence and bookings made on behalf of someone else; these values come from a RulesProvider (booking/rules.py, environment variables by default) so they can be changed without code changes. Authentication and resource-specific eligibility are separate. Verified induction expires a fixed number of days after approval (qualification_validity_days from the RulesProvider, default 120, one term); reviewers do not supply an expiry. Admin and Manager can query the audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations. The prototype seed has 2 labs and 20 independently bookable devices. A Manager has every Admin permission and can also configure booking policies, add staff accounts and deactivate accounts. Admins cannot use any Manager endpoint. Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts whose role is fixed when created: students are never promoted to staff, and Admin and Manager do not switch. Creating, approving, automatically deciding, promoting from the waitlist and rescheduling all use one shared rule check (account active, resource available, valid time, booking window on create and reschedule, induction and prerequisites). A Manager can mark a resource MAINTENANCE or CLOSED (new requests paused, existing bookings kept) and list or export every booking. Staff accounts are created with Add staff (POST /admin/users/staff/). Equipment records the room it is kept in (room_id); a room's maintenance does not affect its equipment. Two sign-in entry points: students use university sign-in (demo: POST /auth/demo-login/, which refuses staff with USE_STAFF_SIGN_IN); Admins and Managers use the staff page with zID and password (POST /auth/staff-sign-in/). A Manager's Add staff issues an invite code that the staff member uses once to choose a password (POST /auth/staff-activate/); Reset access issues a new code. Password hashes never appear in responses. Outlook sync is one way. The system never reads changes made in Outlook, so nothing done there can bypass the rules or become an approved booking; if a person deleted the event, a Manager's reschedule writes it again at the new time. Invitations follow OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE (default allowlist: only OUTLOOK_ALLOWED_ATTENDEES are invited). POST /admin/outlook/check/ tests the Microsoft sign-in. Resources have an equipment category, and GET /resources/day-overview/ returns every matching resource's free and taken times on one day for the booking page filter and grid. Demo staff accounts use the password 123. Each person has a private calendar subscription link (GET calendar/link/, feed GET calendar/{token}.ics) that Outlook, Google or Apple Calendar read by themselves. Website notifications (GET notifications/) tell people about decisions and changes. Approved bookings need a check-in (POST bookings/{id}/check-in/) around the start; at the fourth missed check-in (configurable) booking is frozen for 30 days, later bookings are cancelled, and staff decide unfreeze requests. A person may hold at most 24 half-hour slots per local week (configurable), including pending, waitlisted, approved and weekly-series dates. Staff can book a weekly series (bookings/series/), approved at once. Managers add, edit, archive and restore rooms and equipment (admin/resources/) and read a usage report (admin/reports/usage/). Staff change their own password (auth/change-password/). Reminders appear in the notification bell the day before an approved booking and when a verified induction expires soon. Additional-hours requests use a separate endpoint and never hold capacity while pending. Managers may approve only within a configurable window before the requested start (48 hours by default), after rechecking capacity, eligibility and priority/FIFO order. These exact-slot grants are separate from the ordinary weekly allowance, retain the normal single-booking duration, future-booking count and maximum advance limits, and cannot be moved or automatically approved.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: 1.24.0 Manager override: a Manager's booking (for themselves or on behalf, not a change request) is APPROVED at once with reason_code MANAGER_OVERRIDE. It skips the induction, booking window, per-booking (normal 3 h), weekly and future-booking limits and the freeze; the resource must still be bookable, the time within its opening hours, its own maximum length and time steps, and free (BOOKING_CONFLICT 409 instead of a waitlist place). Everything below applies to everyone else. Any active account: Admins book under the same rules as students and Admins and Managers may book on behalf of someone else with on_behalf_of_zid; the booking belongs to that person (student_id, whose induction is checked) and created_by records the creator. Urgent requests (urgent=true, urgent_reason) may start inside the minimum advance window; they are PENDING_APPROVAL with reason URGENT_AWAITING_MANAGER, review_due_at null and hold_until = start, only a Manager can decide them (URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER) and they expire at the start if undecided. Requires a VERIFIED, unexpired induction for the selected resource, and for each of its prerequisite inductions, through the booking end; otherwise 403 QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED (details.qualification_status, requirement_id; PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED adds prerequisite_id and prerequisite_status), including while evidence is still PENDING. The local start date must be from today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 7) to today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 28, or 4 weeks): BOOKING_TOO_SOON / BOOKING_TOO_FAR_AHEAD (400, details.earliest_date, latest_date, min_advance_days, max_advance_days). A user who already has an overlapping active request for this same resource receives DUPLICATE_BOOKING (409); terminal requests do not block rebooking and different resources remain independent. If no APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (reason AWAITING_REVIEW) with review_due_at = hold_until = min(start, now + pending_hold_minutes, default 1440). An Admin/Manager decides within that window; when it ends undecided the system re-checks the rules and sets APPROVED (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) or REJECTED (AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES or AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT), reviewed_by SYSTEM. If an APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes WAITLISTED (reason TIME_CONFLICT or TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT) with waitlist_position. When time frees up (cancellation, rejection, expiry, rescheduling, an automatic rejection or a resource reopening) the earliest waitlisted request that now fits becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST) with a fresh review window, or REJECTED with the failing rule's code (for example QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED or ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Only APPROVED creates an Outlook event. Undecided and waitlisted requests expire at their start time. HTTP 201 never means approved. Interval semantics are [start, end). Booking frozen after missed check-ins: 403 ACCOUNT_FROZEN (details.frozen_until). At most MAX_SLOTS_PER_WEEK (default 24) half-hour slots per person per local week (Monday to Sunday), counting pending, waitlisted, approved and staff-created series bookings: 409 WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED (details.limit_slots, used_slots, requested_slots, remaining_slots, slot_minutes, week_start). At most MAX_ACTIVE_FUTURE_BOOKINGS (default 8) pending, waitlisted or approved bookings that have not started per person: 409 FUTURE_BOOKING_LIMIT_REACHED (details.limit, used, requested, remaining). An explicitly enabled self-only test session may bypass booking policy; see auth/test-session/. Bypass availability uses latest_date=null, test_bypass=true and no review wait.

A VERIFIED decision sets valid_until to the review time plus the configured validity period (default 120 days, one term); it lets the user submit booking requests but does not approve any booking. A REJECTED decision requires a reason and rejects the user's undecided bookings (PENDING_APPROVAL and WAITLISTED) for resources requiring this qualification with reason_code QUALIFICATION_REJECTED and the same reason, releasing their slots and offering them to the waitlist. updated_bookings lists every booking changed. valid_until is not accepted in the request; sending it returns 400.

post.summary: Approve or reject a booking request
post.description: Admin or Manager only; an Admin cannot decide their own request (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN, 403). Decide within the request's review window (review_due_at); afterwards ordinary requests receive an automatic decision, while longer-booking requests expire without a Manager decision. APPROVED is allowed only for PENDING_APPROVAL requests; it re-checks resource-specific qualification through the booking end and conflicts with APPROVED bookings and other active pending requests, excluding this request's own ID. A WAITLISTED request cannot be approved (REQUEST_WAITLISTED, 409); it moves up in order. REJECTED (reason required) may be applied to PENDING_APPROVAL or WAITLISTED requests; rejecting a pending request offers its time to the next waitlisted request. BOOKING_HOLD_CONFLICT (409) includes details.hold_until; BOOKING_CONFLICT (409) indicates an approved blocker. Nobody can decide a request that is for them or that they created (403 SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN). Urgent requests can be decided only by a Manager (403 URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER). Additional-hours requests require Manager role for either decision and prohibit review by the beneficiary or creator. Approval is allowed from start minus ADDITIONAL_HOURS_APPROVAL_WINDOW_HOURS (default 48) until before start, and rechecks capacity, eligibility and overlapping priority/FIFO order inside the transaction. A claimed active-data-collection priority requires confirm_active_data_collection=true. Rejection requires a reason and may occur before the approval window opens. Successful approval records the exact start/end, Manager and priority/confirmation snapshot in the audit log. Longer-booking requests require a Manager for either decision. Approval rechecks resource technical duration, opening hours, induction, freeze, normal weekly/future limits and capacity; only the normal per-booking duration cap is waived. Pending long requests expire at review_due_at even if the normal cap later increases.

400.description: Invalid fields, review time, duration or resource opening-hour rules. DATA_COLLECTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED if the Manager has not confirmed a collection claim.

403.description: Role restriction or SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN. Only a Manager can decide longer-booking or additional-hours requests; the beneficiary and creator cannot review their own request.

409.description: Missing valid qualification, approved or pending-request conflict, REQUEST_WAITLISTED, or invalid booking state. Approval re-runs the shared rule check: ACCOUNT_INACTIVE (the requester's account was deactivated) or QUALIFICATION_NOT_VERIFIED (details.qualification_status, including PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED). ADDITIONAL_HOURS_TOO_EARLY, ADDITIONAL_HOURS_NO_CAPACITY, ADDITIONAL_HOURS_QUEUE_PRIORITY, or another current eligibility restriction. Longer-booking approval may also fail WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED or FUTURE_BOOKING_LIMIT_REACHED after a policy change.

patch.summary: Deactivate or reactivate an account (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. Send active (and optionally role, which must equal the current role). Roles are fixed when an account is created: Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts, so any role change returns 409 ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED; to replace someone, add a new staff account and deactivate the old one. Takes effect on the user's next request; a deactivated user receives 401. Managers cannot change their own status (SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN, 403), and at least one active Manager must remain (LAST_MANAGER, 409). Deactivating a student rejects their undecided (pending and waitlisted) requests with ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED and promotes the waitlist; approved bookings are kept. Every change writes a USER_UPDATED audit record with previous and new values.

post.summary: Ask to move your approved booking (change request)
post.description: 1.16.0. Only the person the booking is for, and only for a future APPROVED booking (409 REQUEST_NOT_CHANGEABLE otherwise; others receive 404 or 403). Creates a new request on the same resource with replaces_id set and the same purpose. It follows the normal request rules (booking window, opening hours, length, induction, freeze, weekly limit, where the old booking does not count). Free time: PENDING_APPROVAL with a review window; taken or held time: WAITLISTED. The old booking stays until the new request is approved (by an Admin, by the system when the review window ends, or after moving up the waitlist); then it is cancelled with reason_code REPLACED_BY_CHANGE and its time is offered to the waitlist. If the change is rejected, withdrawn or expires, the old booking stays. One open change per booking (409 CHANGE_ALREADY_REQUESTED with details.booking_id). The same time as now is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Notifications CHANGE_REQUESTED, CHANGE_APPROVED, CHANGE_REJECTED. Optional Idempotency-Key header as for POST bookings/. Approved additional-hours grants cannot be moved: ADDITIONAL_HOURS_NEW_REQUEST_REQUIRED (409). Cancel and submit a fresh request for the new slot. Longer-booking exemptions cannot be moved: LONG_BOOKING_NEW_REQUEST_REQUIRED (409); cancel and submit a new longer-booking request.

post.description: Create an unheld PENDING_APPROVAL request with review_due_at=null and hold_until=null, even before its approval window opens. An active eligible user can request for themselves; staff can request for another person. There is no requirement to exhaust the normal weekly allowance first. Pending and approved additional-hours records do not consume ordinary weekly slots, but count towards the same active-future-booking limit. The minimum advance days are waived for this flow; the normal per-booking duration, opening hours, increments, induction, freeze and maximum advance window still apply. Overlapping extra requests may be submitted without reserving capacity. Manager approval is manual, within the configured hours before start, and requires unused capacity after normal reservations and holds. Priority and FIFO are enforced at approval; data-collection claims require explicit confirmation. No automatic approval or ordinary waitlist promotion occurs. Unreviewed requests expire at their start. Approval grants only this exact slot; changes/reschedules require cancellation and a fresh additional-hours request. Idempotency checks include request type, beneficiary, reason and collection claim; clients cannot set approval or priority fields.

post.description: Separate request to exceed only the configured normal single-booking cap (default 3 hours). Duration must exceed that cap and stay within the resource technical maximum. Normal weekly allowance, future-booking count, advance window, opening hours, increments, induction and freeze checks still apply, including staff requests on behalf of others. Cannot combine with urgent requests, additional hours or recurring series. Free time creates PENDING_APPROVAL with the normal resource review deadline and active hold; occupied time creates WAITLISTED in the normal FIFO queue. Only a Manager may approve or reject, and neither the beneficiary nor creator may review. An unreviewed pending request expires at its review deadline, never automatically approves, and releases the slot to the queue. Approval rechecks current rules, weekly/future limits and conflicts. The approved exemption applies to this exact resource/start/end; changes require cancellation and a new request. Idempotency includes request kind, reason, beneficiary and exact booking details.

A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

room_id.description: Equipment only: the room it is kept in (null for rooms). Used for grouping; a room's status does not affect its equipment.

details.description: 1.16.0: "label: value" lines a Manager adds (model, floor, specs...).

file_id.description: Evidence UUID for normal submissions; empty for automatic local test-account grants without a file.

valid_until.description: Set by the server when VERIFIED: review time plus the configured validity period. Null for PENDING or REJECTED. Bookings must end no later than this time.

effective_status.description: Current derived status, including expiry; the stored review status remains in status.

file_url.description: Private API path; Bearer authentication is still required. Empty for automatic local test-account grants, which have no evidence file.

file.description: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 5 MiB; validated by the server.

status.description: PENDING_APPROVAL is undecided: normal and longer requests hold the slot until review_due_at; additional-hours requests never hold capacity. WAITLISTED is queued without a hold. Only APPROVED is confirmed. WAITING_QUALIFICATION remains for legacy data.

reason_code.description: Why the request is in its status, e.g. AWAITING_REVIEW, AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW, AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT, TIME_CONFLICT, TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT, PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, START_TIME_PASSED, CANCELLED_BY_USER, CANCELLED_BY_STAFF, URGENT_AWAITING_MANAGER, RESCHEDULED_BY_MANAGER, SERIES_CREATED_BY_STAFF (weekly series, approved at creation), ACCOUNT_FROZEN (cancelled when the person's booking was frozen). Longer-booking values include LONG_BOOKING_AWAITING_MANAGER, LONG_BOOKING_WAITLISTED, LONG_BOOKING_APPROVED, LONG_BOOKING_REJECTED and LONG_BOOKING_REVIEW_EXPIRED.

review_due_at.description: Review deadline, equal to hold_until while pending. Ordinary requests receive an automatic decision at this deadline; longer-booking requests expire without a Manager decision. Null for additional-hours and waitlisted requests.

reviewed_by.description: Id of the Admin/Manager who decided, or SYSTEM for an automatic decision.

hold_until.description: Historical hold deadline; use hold_active to determine current occupancy.

hold_active.description: PENDING_APPROVAL and hold_until strictly later than server time.

blocks_slot.description: True for APPROVED or a pending request whose review window is active. Never true for WAITLISTED.

waitlist_position.description: 1-based place among waitlisted requests overlapping this one on the same resource, in submission order. Null unless WAITLISTED.

created_by.description: Who created the request. student_id is the person it is for; an Admin or Manager may book on behalf of someone. null for records created before 1.10.0 (migration 004 fills it with student_id).

booked_for.description: The person the booking is for (student_id).

on_behalf.description: true when created_by differs from student_id.

urgent.description: Urgent request: starts inside the minimum advance window; only a Manager can decide it; never decided automatically.

series_id.description: Weekly series made by staff (GET bookings/series/{id}/); null for single bookings.

attendance.description: Approved bookings only. CHECKED_IN: the person pressed I'm here in time. NO_SHOW: the check-in time passed without one (counts towards a booking freeze). EXCUSED: the resource was under maintenance or closed. NOT_TRACKED: started before check-in existed. null: not decided yet.

check_in_open.description: True while the person the booking is for can check in now (POST bookings/{id}/check-in/).

check_in_opens_at.description: Approved and not yet checked: check-in opens (start minus CHECK_IN_OPENS_MINUTES).

check_in_closes_at.description: Approved and not yet checked: check-in closes (start plus CHECK_IN_CLOSES_MINUTES, never after the end); afterwards the booking counts as missed.

replaces_id.description: 1.16.0: on a change request, the approved booking it would replace. That booking stays until this request is approved, then it is cancelled automatically (reason_code REPLACED_BY_CHANGE).

replaces_booking.description: 1.16.0: the booking named by replaces_id (time and status).

open_change.description: 1.16.0: on an approved booking, its change request that is still pending or waitlisted.

long_booking.description: Separate Manager-reviewed exemption from only the normal single-booking duration cap.

on_behalf_of_zid.description: Admin/Manager only: book for the active account with this zID (403 FORBIDDEN for students; 404 PERSON_NOT_FOUND; 409 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Eligibility is checked for that person.

urgent.description: Urgent request for a start sooner than the minimum advance window (URGENT_NOT_NEEDED if the start is inside the normal window). Requires urgent_reason; the time must be free (409 BOOKING_CONFLICT, no waitlist).

urgent_reason.description: For urgent requests, the single explanation shown in the UI also supplies purpose. Both API fields remain required as before.

end.description: New end with a UTC offset, later than the current end.

max_booking_minutes.description: Effective duration cap: normal configured cap, or the resource technical maximum aligned to selection_step_minutes in longer-booking mode.

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

requested_by_me.description: True when the current user already has an overlapping active request for this resource; clients must not submit it again.

can_request.description: Whether the active beneficiary has current induction, is not frozen and the resource is bookable. Staff requests use for_zid when provided. In longer-booking mode, false if the resource has no selectable duration above the normal cap. Submission rechecks the selected period and all limits. 1.24.0: for a Manager only an active person and a bookable resource.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time. PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED means a prerequisite induction (see missing_prerequisite_id) is not verified and current.

earliest_date.description: First local date a booking may start on (today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS).

latest_date.description: Last permitted local booking date. Null only for an enabled test session with booking-rule bypass.

review_window_minutes.description: Resource review deadline length; longer requests expire without a Manager decision. Zero only for ordinary development test bypass.

missing_prerequisite_id.description: Set when qualification_status is PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED: the requirement to complete first.

frozen_until.description: Set while the person being booked for is frozen; can_request is then false.

manager_override.description: 1.24.0: true for a Manager (not in additional-hours or longer-booking mode): the booking window, induction and freeze do not apply, latest_date is null, max_booking_minutes is the resource's own maximum and can_request only needs an active person and a bookable resource.

normal_max_booking_minutes.description: Effective ordinary single-booking cap from the current rules and resource.

min_booking_minutes.description: Minimum final selection: first selectable increment above the normal cap for longer requests, otherwise the selection step. Small duration_minutes timeline queries remain allowed.

confirm_active_data_collection.description: Must be true to approve an additional-hours request claiming ongoing data collection. This confirms that the Manager verified the explanation.

week_hours.description: Hours of the weekly allowance booked in the current Sydney week (Monday to Sunday): pending, waitlisted and approved bookings, weekly series included, additional hours not counted.

sso_connected.description: Always false; university SSO is not integrated yet.

staff_sign_in_enabled.description: Admins and Managers can sign in on the staff page with zID and password.

configured.description: Local configuration exists; does not prove valid Graph authorization.

code.description: TOKEN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_LOGIN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED, GRAPH_HTTP_403, OUTLOOK_CALENDAR_READ_ONLY, GRAPH_NETWORK_ERROR, ...

last_check.description: Latest connection check in this server process; reading this page never calls Microsoft.

items.description: One row per synchronised booking, failures first (development view).

pending_hold_minutes.description: Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

actor_id.description: User UUID, or SYSTEM for automatic time processing and calendar sync.

action.description: For example BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_APPROVED, BOOKING_REJECTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REEVALUATED, BOOKING_TIME_PROCESSED, QUALIFICATION_SUBMITTED, QUALIFICATION_VERIFIED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, RESOURCE_BOOKING_POLICY_UPDATED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_SUCCEEDED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_FAILED, DEMO_STUDENT_CREATED.

details.description: Action-specific values such as status, reason_code, reason, old/new times or valid_until.

actor.description: Null for SYSTEM or an unknown user.

role.description: Optional; must equal the current role. Roles are fixed when the account is created, so a different value returns 409 ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED.

active.description: false locks the account out on its next request and rejects a student's undecided requests (ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED); true restores it.

reason.description: Required for MAINTENANCE and CLOSED; shown to students. Ignored for AVAILABLE.

expected_back.description: Optional recovery estimate shown in the resource status announcement; does not reopen or expire it automatically.

affected_bookings.description: Future approved or undecided bookings on this resource, kept as they are so the Manager can decide whether to cancel them (POST /bookings/{id}/cancel/ marks them CANCELLED_BY_STAFF).

no_show_count.description: Missed check-ins since the last booking freeze.

frozen_until.description: Booking is frozen until this time after too many missed check-ins (null: not frozen).

booking_frozen.description: True while frozen_until is in the future: nobody can book for this person. Reviewing rights of staff are unaffected.

inductions.description: Every induction requirement with this person's current status.

induction_status.description: VERIFIED only when every induction is verified and not expired. Only meaningful for students.

is_staff.description: true for ADMIN and MANAGER (staff accounts; they may also book).

activation_status.description: Staff only (null for students): whether they have chosen a password with their invite code.

invite_code.description: Staff awaiting activation only: the code a Manager hands over. Null once activated and for students.

code.description: TOKEN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_LOGIN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED, GRAPH_HTTP_403, OUTLOOK_CALENDAR_READ_ONLY, GRAPH_NETWORK_ERROR, ...

booked_by.description: Set only when staff booked on behalf of someone.

invited.description: Whether the person receives a meeting invitation (OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE).

room_name.description: Equipment: the room it is kept in.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time. PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED means a prerequisite induction (see missing_prerequisite_id) is not verified and current.

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

requested_by_me.description: True when the current user already has an overlapping active request for this resource; clients must not submit it again.

latest_date.description: Last permitted local booking date. Null only for an enabled test session with booking-rule bypass.

categories.description: Equipment types in use, for the filter.

results.description: Rooms first, then equipment, by name.

too_long.description: 1.16.0: resources left out because they cannot be booked for duration_minutes (longer than their maximum or not on their time steps). Such a length is no longer a 400 error.

not_bookable.description: 1.16.0: with bookable_only, hidden rows counted by reason: MAINTENANCE / CLOSED, FROZEN, or the induction status (NOT_SUBMITTED, PENDING, PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED, ...).

manager_override.description: 1.24.0: present (true) for a Manager: the window starts today and has no last date.

kind.description: BOOKING_SUBMITTED (your own request was received), BOOKING_APPROVED, BOOKING_REJECTED, BOOKING_PROMOTED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, BOOKING_CREATED_FOR_YOU, SERIES_CREATED (staff member's own weekly series), SERIES_CREATED_FOR_YOU, URGENT_REQUEST (Managers), QUALIFICATION_VERIFIED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, NO_SHOW_RECORDED, ACCOUNT_FROZEN, UNFREEZE_APPROVED, UNFREEZE_REJECTED, ACCOUNT_UNFROZEN, BOOKING_EXPIRED (waitlisted or undecided request reached its start), BOOKING_REMINDER (the day before an approved booking), INDUCTION_EXPIRING (a verified induction expires soon). 1.16.0: CHANGE_REQUESTED, CHANGE_APPROVED, CHANGE_REJECTED (change requests), RESOURCE_OUT_OF_SERVICE (a resource you have a booking or request on went under maintenance or closed, with the reason) and RESOURCE_REOPENED. When email is on, the kinds in EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_KINDS are also emailed.

link.description: Web app page to open, e.g. /bookings.

in_app.description: Channel selected at creation time; email-only records never enter the bell.

email.description: Channel selected at creation time; email-only records never enter the bell.

unread_count.description: All unread notifications, not only the returned page.

path.description: Relative address of the private feed; prefix the site address. Anyone with it can read the feed.

reason.description: Required when REJECTED; shown to the person.

no_show_count.description: Missed check-ins since the last booking freeze.

frozen_until.description: Booking is frozen until this time after too many missed check-ins (null: not frozen).

booking_frozen.description: True while frozen_until is in the future: nobody can book for this person. Reviewing rights of staff are unaffected.

on_behalf_of_zid.description: Book for this person instead of yourself.
Book for this person instead of yourself.

skip_dates.description: Dates to leave out; every date the preview marks as not available must be listed.

reason_code.description: Why the date cannot be booked: BOOKING_CONFLICT, DUPLICATE_BOOKING, BOOKING_TOO_SOON, OUTSIDE_OPENING_HOURS, INVALID_TIME_INCREMENT, DURATION_LIMIT, INVALID_TIME, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.

name.description: Unique among listed resources (case is ignored).

required_qualification_id.description: Induction people need to book it.

room_id.description: Equipment only: the listed room it is kept in.

category.description: Equipment only: equipment type for the booking page filter.

max_booking_minutes.description: A multiple of slot_minutes that fits within the opening hours.

opening_time.description: Local time HH:MM, on a slot_minutes step.

closing_time.description: After opening_time, on a slot_minutes step.

details.description: 1.16.0: at most 12 non-empty lines; empty rows are dropped. Replaces the list.

ResourceUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change. kind cannot change (409 KIND_IS_FIXED).

name.description: Unique among listed resources (case is ignored).

required_qualification_id.description: Induction people need to book it.

room_id.description: Equipment only: the listed room it is kept in.

category.description: Equipment only: equipment type for the booking page filter.

max_booking_minutes.description: A multiple of slot_minutes that fits within the opening hours.

opening_time.description: Local time HH:MM, on a slot_minutes step.

closing_time.description: After opening_time, on a slot_minutes step.

details.description: 1.16.0: at most 12 non-empty lines; empty rows are dropped. Replaces the list.

ResourceCreate.description: A room has no room_id and no category.

bookings_outside_rules.description: Future pending, waitlisted or approved bookings that no longer fit the new rules. They are kept; a Manager decides.

status.description: PENDING_APPROVAL is an undecided request that holds its slot until review_due_at; WAITLISTED is queued behind an earlier booking or request and never holds a slot; only APPROVED is confirmed. WAITING_QUALIFICATION appears only in early data; the current flow never creates it.

reason_code.description: Why the request is in its status, e.g. AWAITING_REVIEW, AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW, AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT, TIME_CONFLICT, TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT, PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, START_TIME_PASSED, CANCELLED_BY_USER, CANCELLED_BY_STAFF, URGENT_AWAITING_MANAGER, RESCHEDULED_BY_MANAGER, SERIES_CREATED_BY_STAFF (weekly series, approved at creation), ACCOUNT_FROZEN (cancelled when the person's booking was frozen).

review_due_at.description: End of the Admin review window for a PENDING_APPROVAL request (same as hold_until). After it the system approves or rejects the request automatically.

reviewed_by.description: Id of the Admin/Manager who decided, or SYSTEM for an automatic decision.

hold_until.description: Historical hold deadline; use hold_active to determine current occupancy.

hold_active.description: PENDING_APPROVAL and hold_until strictly later than server time.

blocks_slot.description: True for APPROVED or a pending request whose review window is active. Never true for WAITLISTED.

waitlist_position.description: 1-based place among waitlisted requests overlapping this one on the same resource, in submission order. Null unless WAITLISTED.

created_by.description: Who created the request. student_id is the person it is for; an Admin or Manager may book on behalf of someone. null for records created before 1.10.0 (migration 004 fills it with student_id).

booked_for.description: The person the booking is for (student_id).

on_behalf.description: true when created_by differs from student_id.

urgent.description: Urgent request: starts inside the minimum advance window; only a Manager can decide it; never decided automatically.

series_id.description: Weekly series made by staff (GET bookings/series/{id}/); null for single bookings.

attendance.description: Approved bookings only. CHECKED_IN: the person pressed I'm here in time. NO_SHOW: the check-in time passed without one (counts towards a booking freeze). EXCUSED: the resource was under maintenance or closed. NOT_TRACKED: started before check-in existed. null: not decided yet.

check_in_open.description: True while the person the booking is for can check in now (POST bookings/{id}/check-in/).

check_in_opens_at.description: Approved and not yet checked: check-in opens (start minus CHECK_IN_OPENS_MINUTES).

check_in_closes_at.description: Approved and not yet checked: check-in closes (start plus CHECK_IN_CLOSES_MINUTES, never after the end); afterwards the booking counts as missed.

problem.description: Rule the booking now breaks, e.g. OUTSIDE_OPENING_HOURS, DURATION_LIMIT, INVALID_TIME_INCREMENT, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED.

BookingOutsideRules.description: A booking (as in Admin/Manager lists) that no longer fits the resource's new rules.

BookingTimeRef.description: 1.16.0: time and status of a linked booking.

RequirementFields.description: 1.16.0: induction texts a Manager writes. name 1-120 characters and unique (case ignored, 409 REQUIREMENT_NAME_TAKEN); description up to 1000; each guidance text up to 2000.

RequirementUpdate.description: 1.16.0: any of the texts and/or prerequisite_ids (replaces the list).

SiteContact.description: 1.16.0: the lab's contact details (one record). Empty strings until a Manager saves them; the website shows only filled-in fields.

SiteContactUpdate.description: Any of the fields; an empty string clears it. email must look like an address.

pending_bookings.description: Ordinary pending requests, excluding urgent, additional-hours and longer-booking requests.

due_soon.description: Pending requests whose review window ends within due_soon_hours, soonest first (at most 10).

today.description: Approved bookings starting today (Sydney), at most 10.

additional_hours_ready.description: Business-ready pending requests; role, self-review and claim confirmation checks still apply.

long_booking_requests.description: Pending longer-booking requests needing a Manager decision.

can_decide_long_bookings.description: True only for a Manager; self/creator review remains forbidden.

on_behalf_of_zid.description: Admin/Manager only: book for the active account with this zID (403 FORBIDDEN for students; 404 PERSON_NOT_FOUND; 409 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Eligibility is checked for that person.

active_data_collection.description: Claim of ongoing data collection; provisional priority, subject to explicit Manager verification.

data_collection_reason.description: Required nonblank when active_data_collection is true; otherwise blank or omitted.

can_approve.description: Current business eligibility only. Manager role, no-self-review and collection-claim confirmation are enforced separately.

AdditionalHoursReview.description: Current, recomputed eligibility and ordering among overlapping same-resource additional-hours requests. No-use priority means no already-started CHECKED_IN booking across any resource in the requested booking local Monday-Sunday week. Collection claims have equal provisional priority; each claim must be verified by the approving Manager. Eligible requests within each group follow created_at then id. Noneligible requests do not block the queue. Approval audit retains the decision-time snapshot.

on_behalf_of_zid.description: Admin/Manager only: book for the active account with this zID (403 FORBIDDEN for students; 404 PERSON_NOT_FOUND; 409 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Eligibility is checked for that person.

long_booking_reason.description: Why this exact booking requires more than the configured normal duration cap.
